cards.countSource: corrected 2026-07-26: NamuWiki listed the third copy as 4-player-only, but each of Civil decks I/II/III contains exactly three copies marked '4' and six marked '3+' (RB p.4, CoL p.2). With Computers, Air Forces and Professional Sports carrying the Age III '4' marks, Democracy's extra copy must be a '3+' copy; the 2006 edition also added Democracy at 3 players.

note: Civil technologies only; the Age A entries are the six technologies printed on the player boards (count 0, not deck cards). Deck sizes: Age A civil deck = 6 leaders + 4 wonders + 10 action cards = 20; Ages I/II/III = 30 technologies + 6 leaders + 4 wonders + 13 action cards = 53 at 4 players (50 at 3, 44 at 2).
